item.title: Binance’s net inflows turn positive at $2.3B as withdrawals expand
item.description: Binance led exchanges in 24-hour net inflows, reversing Monday’s heavy outflows as it restored access to funds after its $6.3 billion hack.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: France postpones 2027 budget vote, crypto exit-tax proposals scrapped
item.description: The National Assembly postponed the vote on the budget’s revenue section for the second time, while the Nov. 17 deadline for the first reading examination nears.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater
item.description: Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort in a move that risked flipping it to new resistance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: ARK buys $17M in Coinbase, Circle shares while trimming Bullish
item.description: ARK Invest added Coinbase and Circle shares across two trading sessions while selling about $8 million in Bullish as crypto stocks declined.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Suspected EU crypto theft estimate rises to $133M: ZachXBT
item.description: ZachXBT identified another $27 million in exchange withdrawals, some of which occurred after he first flagged the suspected crypto theft.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: BlackRock’s IBIT sees biggest Bitcoin ETF outflows since June
item.description: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF shed $405.3 million on Monday as US spot Bitcoin funds opened November with nearly $399 million in net outflows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Crypto.com to withdraw Hong Kong consumer app citing regulatory changes
item.description: Crypto.com will discontinue its consumer app services in Hong Kong in February next year.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Australia lifts rates to 18-year high as AI boom, energy costs fuel inflation
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its benchmark rate to 4.85% on rising technology costs from AI investment and higher energy prices.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: UK warns AI ransomware attack on infrastructure ‘highly likely’ by 2028
item.description: The warning comes as UK cyber officials also flag growing threats from state-backed hackers targeting government officials and politicians.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Binance begins second withdrawal phase, exchange outflows slow
item.description: The exchange says additional assets will become available for withdrawal from 04:00 UTC on Tuesday as security checks are completed, following an initial reopening on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: South Korea urges exchanges to boost cold storage after Binance hack
item.description: South Korean crypto exchanges are already required to hold at least 80% of customer crypto in cold wallets, but the regulator is urging more.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: North Korea denies role in $6.3B Binance hack, points finger at US
item.description: Pyongyang has pushed back against the FBI’s attribution of the Binance attack, with Kim Yo Jong calling the US allegations politically motivated.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: New Jersey drops Coinbase staking order ahead of crypto’s midterm test
item.description: New Jersey lifted its staking ban and dropped a $5 million penalty, clearing the way for Coinbase to restore staking access for users in the US state.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: AI poses greater threat to Bitcoin than quantum computing, Swan founder says
item.description: The Swan Bitcoin founder warned that hackers are using large language models to exploit security flaws with just a few prompts.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Crypto investigators flag suspected $106M theft, $786K Solana bot drain
item.description: A European entity may have lost $106 million from exchange accounts, while a wallet associated with a Solana arbitrage bot may have lost another $786,000.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Coinbase hit with 50% price target cut as post-earnings rout deepens
item.description: Slowing trading activity and fallout from the Binance hack are clouding Coinbase’s revenue prospects, prompting Morgan Stanley to lower its rating on the stock.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin risks drop below $76K as 7% oil slide fails to spark BTC price rally
item.description: Bitcoin fell around 1.7% on Monday as stocks pared early gains fueled by hopes of a diplomatic resolution to the US-Iran war.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Mercado Bitcoin wallets show post-hack transfers after $46M theft
item.description: Brazil’s exchange Mercado Bitcoin paused deposits and withdrawals after a security breach, saying customer funds and data were safe.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Animoca Brands clears final hurdle for Abu Dhabi fund management
item.description: The former mobile games company is building out its fund management business in Abu Dhabi as it targets institutional demand for stablecoins and tokenized assets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Strategy spends triple its weekly Bitcoin outlay on STRC buybacks
item.description: Strategy spent $208.2 million buying back STRC preferred shares and $65.5 million on Bitcoin, while allocating $98.5 million to its USD Cash balance.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents
item.description: Who better to judge a dispute between AI agents than a jury of different AI models? That’s the idea behind GenLayer, which is already issuing thousands of judgements each day.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Binance taps half its SAFU Bitcoin holdings, releases reserve proof
item.description: Binance’s SAFU Bitcoin wallet now holds about 7,500 BTC after a 7,499 BTC transfer linked to the hack, with no timeline for restoring the $1 billion fund.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: FATF targets crypto hubs in review of money laundering controls
item.description: The watchdog has not named the jurisdictions under review. Initial findings on compliance with its crypto standards are due in June 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
item.description: Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: From Uptober to Hacktober: Are Bitcoin’s seasonal patterns becoming obsolete?
item.description: Bitcoin lost 7.3% in October 2026 after another decline the previous year, despite the month’s historically strong returns, as analysts reassess seasonal signals.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Trezor lifts password ceiling after Coldcard’s $100M wallet thefts
item.description: Trezor cited July’s Coldcard attacks, in which strong passphrases helped protect some users whose wallet recovery information was compromised.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Hong Kong takes tokenized settlement to 24/7, plans stablecoin trials
item.description: The HKMA plans to bring regulated stablecoins into tokenized government debt trials, while HSBC says its RedCoin stablecoin has reached 50,000 users.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: BTC heads into US midterm showdown: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
item.description: Bitcoin price action held its 100-day moving average into the monthly close as crypto markets braced for US midterm election and tech earnings volatility.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: OKX draws $445M in net inflows as Binance outflows exceed $7B
item.description: OKX led cryptocurrency exchanges with $445 million in daily inflows, while Binance processed about $7 billion in net outflows.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
